# Establishment log — popol-vuh-009 (image 0033 from line 18, 0034, and 0035 to line 29)

Read 2026-11-25 from source/pages/i0033 (from line 18, after `… ruꜭ Cabracan, varal chuvach vleuh.`), all of
i0034 and the first 29 lines of i0035, in strips of about five lines at 1×, with 2× crops of every doubtful
word, checked word by word against Brasseur 1861 (OCR lines 21325–21720 and 21808–21890). Start:
`Are chicut xchi ca biyh chic v bi qui cahau …` (0033 l.18). End: `… cumal Hunahpu, Xbalanque.` (0035 l.29),
the end of Brasseur's "Deuxième partie, chapitre premier". popol-vuh-010 begins at 0035 l.30 with
`Catecut qui petic zamahel rumal Huncame, Vvcub Came …` (the owl messengers).

Content: the fathers of Hunahpu and Xbalanque: Hunhunahpu and Vvcub Hunahpu, sons of Xpiyacoc and Xmucane;
Hunhunahpu's sons Hunbaꜩ and Hunchouen by Xbaquiyalo; the brothers' arts; the ball game and the Voc,
Huracan's messenger; the mother dies; Huncame and Vvcub Came of Xibalba hear the game and take counsel; the
list of the lords of Xibalba and their offices (Xiquiripat, Cuchumaquic; Ahalpuh, Ahalꜫana; Chamiabac,
Chamiaholom; Ahalmez, Ahaltocob; Xic, Patan); they plan to summon the brothers.

## Folios
Counting as 004–008 did (0033 = 12r): 0034 = 12v, 0035 = 13r → `fols. 12r–13r`. The crop of 0034 carries 12
at the top left (again consistent with the folio doubt in QUESTIONS.md, 2026-11-24); the earlier count is kept.

## Letter rule used (002–008's rules, unchanged)
- g-shaped letter → ꜭ: `qui ꜭaholaxic`, `v ꜭahol` ×3, `xa ꜭahol`, `vꜭoheic`, `qui ꜭoheic`, `ruꜭ Huracan`;
  gh → ꜭh: `que vꜭhaxic` ×2, `chuꜭhaxic` ×3, `xe ꜭha`.
- tresillo (ɛ-shaped) → ꜫ: `Ahalꜫana` ×3, `chi pe ꜫana`, `Chuꜫanal` (B. Chuganal; 2× crop: the same letter
  as in ꜫana, not t).
- q-shaped letter where Brasseur has g → ꜫ: `hutaꜫih` (B. hutagih).
- q-shaped `vqux` (0035 l.12; B. OCR `u gux`): printed `vꜭux` 'heart', the known word (Vꜭux Cah); doubtful
  between ꜭ and ꜫ by letter alone.
- plain c / qu kept where Brasseur has g, q or k: `xcacamuh` ×2 (B. ka gamuh), `chi acabal` (B. chi agab),
  `xquicutu` (B. x-qui qutu), `ahcot` (B. ahqot), `cuxic` (B. k'uxic), `xqui cam` (B. qam), `catol ꜩih`
  (B. gatoltzih), `Xiquiripat`, `Cuchumaquic` (B. Xiqiripat, Cuchumaquiq), `quic` ×3 (B. quiq), `xqui cuc`
  (B. c'uq), `qui pachcab` (B. pachgab), `Ahaltocob` ×2 and `chi qui tocota` (B. Ahaltogob / Ahaltocob,
  togo-ta), `nimac` ×2 (B. nimak).
- tz ligature → ꜩ: `vꜩihoxic` ×2, `Hunbaꜩ` ×5, `ahꜩibenai`, `vꜩ`, `ꜩih` ×2, `ꜩiyah`, `ꜩamez`, `ꜩaixic`,
  `queꜩabal`, `qui ꜩuun`.

## Doubtful readings and decisions against Brasseur
- 0033 l.20 a struck-through x before `xcacamuh`; omitted. The first `xcacamuh` could be read `xcoacamuh` (the a
  is badly formed); read `xcacamuh` as the second instance (l.20–21, MS `xca|camuh`).
- 0033 l.25 `chi acabal`: MS `chiacabal` at the line end, then `xealaxic`; Brasseur `chi agab x-e alaxic` (no
  -al). Printed as the image: `acabal`.
- 0033 l.27 `Vvcub Hunahpu`: MS `vvcub | hun ahpu`; names joined as in earlier parts. Likewise `hun baꜩ`,
  `hun chouen`, `hun came` → Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen, Huncame.
- 0033 l.35 `xa pu v cab` (MS `xapu vcab`), B. `u cab` 'the two'; divided as 008's `v cab` 'the second'.
- 0033 l.36 `nimac`: the final letter is blotted; read c (B. nimak). `ahnaoh`, B. OCR `alinaoh`.
- 0033 l.39–40 `v ꜭahol` is written above `hunhunahpu` with a caret (`v gahol`); printed in place, with Brasseur.
- 0033 l.40 `e ahzu`: the z has a long tail that looks like a cedilla (as 006's zakhuluhuh); read z with
  Brasseur (ahzu).
- 0033 l.41 `e ahpub`: the `ah` is blotted/overwritten; read with Brasseur.
- 0034 l.3 `Vcub Hunahpu`: written `vcub` with one v here only (elsewhere `vvcub`); printed as written.
- 0034 l.5 `xa e cacab`: clearly b (B. cacap).
- 0034 l.8 `chi Chipi Caculha`: MS `huracan chichipicaculha`; Brasseur has no `chi`. Printed `chi Chipi Caculha`;
  possibly a dittography.
- 0034 l.10 `libahchi chopon` (B. ch'opon).
- 0034 l.12 `xcaminac ca cut` (MS `xcaminac cacut`), the line Brasseur's OCR partly lost.
- 0034 l.14–15 `micnohic` (B. OCR `quenienotic`), `huminic`; meaning to be checked by the drafter.
- 0034 l.33 `chi` is written above the line between `are` and `curi`; printed in place (`Are chi curi ahau
  Chamiabac`), with Brasseur.
- 0034 l.33–34 `Chamiabac, Chamiaholom` (MS `chamia bac, chamia holom`), but 0035 l.1 `Chamiyabac, Chamiyaholom`
  (MS `chamiya bac chamiyaholom`); each printed as written.
- 0035 l.11 `pa chi` (MS `pa | chi`), B. `pu chi`. Image followed.
- 0035 l.12 `vculel` (B. OCR `u cue!`); `vꜭux`, see above.
- 0035 l.25 `qui yachvach` (MS `qui yach|vach`): the y is faint; with Brasseur.
- 0035 l.26 `qui biye` (MS `qui byc` with a mark over the y): the final letter is an open c or e; Brasseur
  `qui biye`; printed `biye`. Doubtful.
- 0035 l.27 `Hunbaꜩ, Chouen` (no Hun before Chouen), as the image and Brasseur.
- Supralinear words: `v ꜭahol` (0033), `chi` (0034).

## Word division (ours)
`chu vi` (MS `chuvi`), `xa vlaquel` (MS `xavlaquel`), `qui culelaah quib`, `pa hom`, `chi cah`, `que ca chac ta
cut`, `pa ca vi` (MS `pacavi`), `chu yabih`, `chi baquir`, `xu pan`, `chi qui tocota`, `chu xavah`, `ve
chibinic`, `vachzot`, `ca chuvi chic`.

## Paragraphs
Ximénez's paragraphs at 0033 l.18 (Are chicut) and l.24 (large V, `Vae cute vꜩihoxic`); otherwise continuous.
Cut at narrative joints and at each lord of Xibalba (15 paragraphs).
